_doc: NEVER_CONSIDERED — a fifth trial state. These are trials the read-only session verified exist and are IN SCOPE under the registered PICO, yet are absent from EVERY identifier space in the corpus: not screened, not excluded, not declared absent — simply never retrieved. This is the true measure of a search failure and is invisible to the STALE count, PRISMA, and the declared-absent census unless rendered explicitly. Each entry carries external identifiers. A topic with a never-considered trial is STALE.
